quests.quest_description: Subah ki pehli kiran ke saath {{userName}} apni textile shop kholne aata hai. Ravi pehle se ready hai. Regular customers aayenge, local orders honge. Par aaj kuch special hone wala hai — ek bada client Mumbai se aa raha hai.
quests.narrative_moment: Time to open the shop! Your assistant Ravi is already here setting things up. Today starts with local customers, but a big client from Mumbai is expected.
quests.scenario: A textile shop in early morning. Shutters opening, lights turning on. Fabric rolls on wooden shelves. Ravi organizing samples on the display counter.

quests.quest_description: Woh moment aa gaya. Mumbai ka bada wholesaler shop pe aaya hai. Woh fluent English bolta hai, fast aur confident. {{userName}} ki asli test shuru hoti hai.
quests.narrative_moment: The big moment! Mumbai wholesaler Mr. Sharma has arrived. He speaks fast English and expects professional communication. This is your test!
quests.scenario: Shop entrance. A sophisticated businessman in formal attire entering with briefcase. {{userName}} standing to greet.

quests.quest_description: Dopahar ka break. {{userName}} ghar jaata hai lunch ke liye. Family ke saath time, par dimag mein subah ki meeting ghoom rahi hai. Priya notices something is off.
quests.narrative_moment: Lunch break! You are home. Wife Priya is in the kitchen, Amma is there too. But your mind is on the morning meeting. Priya will ask what happened — be honest.
quests.scenario: Home entrance in afternoon. Priya at doorway. {{userName}} removing shoes, looking tired and preoccupied.

quests.quest_description: Lunch ke baad wapas shop. Ravi details deta hai — ek Mr. Ahmed Dubai se interested hai Indian textiles mein. Bohot bada opportunity hai par English mein communication zaroori hai.
quests.narrative_moment: Back at shop! Ravi has exciting news — Dubai investor Mr. Ahmed is interested in your textiles! But the catch is all communication will be in English.
quests.scenario: Shop backroom. Ravi excitedly showing notes. {{userName}} listening intently.

quests.quest_description: Shaam ko ghar. Family together. {{userName}} shares about the Dubai opportunity. Wife Priya, parents — all supportive. Family ka strength business ke liye.
quests.narrative_moment: Evening time, you are home! Time to share the big Dubai news. Priya is excited, Appa is proud, Amma will give blessings.
quests.scenario: Living room. Family gathered. {{userName}} standing, sharing news. Evening lights creating warm ambiance.

quests.quest_description: Preparation week shuru. {{userName}} ne commitment kiya hai. Ravi shop pe help karta hai practice mein. Priya ghar pe. Even daily interactions become practice.
quests.narrative_moment: Practice week begins! Video call with Mr. Ahmed in one week. Ravi will help practice at shop, Priya at home.
quests.scenario: Shop in early morning, before customers. Ravi and {{userName}} practicing. Note cards visible.

quests.quest_description: Meeting se ek din pehle. Final preparations. {{userName}} reviews everything. Nervousness aur excitement dono hai.
quests.narrative_moment: Tomorrow is the big day! Video meeting with Mr. Ahmed. Do final preparations today — review products, build confidence. You are ready!
quests.scenario: Shop office with organized documents. Product samples arranged. Laptop set up for video call test.

quests.quest_description: D-Day. Video meeting with Mr. Ahmed. Sab preparation ka test. {{userName}} English mein baat karta hai — stumbles par continues.
quests.narrative_moment: THE BIG DAY IS HERE! Mr. Ahmed will be on screen. All preparation was for this. Take a deep breath. Even if you stumble, dont stop!
quests.emotional_context: Nervous, deep breathing, ready to try
quests.scenario: Shop office set up for video call. Good lighting. Samples within reach. {{userName}} in formal shirt.

quests.quest_description: Mumbai jaane se pehle ki taiyaari. Family se vidaai, Ravi se last minute tips, aur khud ko mentally ready karna.
quests.narrative_moment: The big trip is here! Going to Mumbai to meet Mr. Ahmed. First say goodbye to family, then get last tips from Ravi. You are ready!
quests.scenario: Bedroom early morning. Suitcase open on bed. Priya folding clothes, packing. Morning light through window. Nervous but excited atmosphere.

quests.quest_description: Taxi mein airport ki taraf. Driver se baat, airport pahunchna, check-in counter pe English mein baat.
quests.narrative_moment: Heading to airport! Talk with taxi driver, then check-in at airport. Handle everything in English!
quests.scenario: Inside taxi. City streets passing by window. Friendly driver making conversation. {{userName}} with small bag in back seat.

quests.quest_description: Waiting area se flight tak. Boarding announcement sunna, seat dhundhna, flight attendant se baat.
quests.narrative_moment: Now waiting for flight! Boarding announcement will come, then board the plane. First business flight — enjoy it!
quests.scenario: Airport gate waiting area. Rows of seats. Display showing Mumbai flight. Fellow passengers waiting. {{userName}} sitting nervously.

quests.quest_description: Mumbai airport pe utarna. Baggage lena, taxi lena, hotel tak jaana. Naye sheher mein navigate karna hai.
quests.narrative_moment: In Mumbai! Now get baggage, take taxi, and go to hotel. First time in big city — exciting!
quests.scenario: Mumbai airport baggage claim. Carousel moving. Display showing flight. Passengers waiting for luggage. Busy atmosphere.

quests.quest_description: Hotel lobby mein. Check-in process, room key lena, bellboy se baat, room mein settle hona.
quests.narrative_moment: In hotel lobby! Do check-in, get room key, and settle in room. Need to use professional English.
quests.scenario: Hotel reception desk. Uniformed staff behind counter. Computer screens. Lobby with sofas and plants. Professional atmosphere.

quests.quest_description: Meeting wali subah. Nervous but prepared. Breakfast, getting ready, final practice.
quests.narrative_moment: The big day is here! Morning of the meeting. Have breakfast, get ready, final practice. You are ready!
quests.scenario: Hotel room early morning. First light through curtains. {{userName}} sitting on bed edge, phone in hand. Nervous energy.

quests.quest_description: Office building mein. Reception, waiting area, aur finally Mr. Ahmed se face-to-face meeting. Sab kuch English mein.
quests.narrative_moment: Reached the office! Check-in at reception, wait, and finally meet Mr. Ahmed. This is the moment you prepared for!
quests.scenario: Corporate office building lobby. Modern interior. Reception desk with company logo. Security desk. Professional atmosphere.

quests.quest_description: Meeting successful! Ab ghar wapsi. Family ko khabar dena, airport jaana, aur victorious homecoming.
quests.narrative_moment: Meeting was successful! Now time to go home. Give good news to family and celebrate — you did it!
quests.scenario: Outside office building. {{userName}} on phone, excited. Mumbai street visible. Just after successful meeting.

quests.quest_description: Mumbai trip successful rahi! Ab formal order aa gaya hai Dubai se. Farhan call karta hai details ke saath. Ravi ke saath planning, Priya ko news, Appa se advice — sab kuch ready karna hai.
quests.narrative_moment: Remember the Mumbai trip? Mr. Ahmed made the deal! Now formal order has come. Understand details and plan!
quests.scenario: Textile shop in the morning. Phone ringing on the wooden counter. Ravi looking up from organizing fabric samples. Sunlight streaming through the glass door. The moment of truth.

quests.quest_description: Order mil gaya, ab production shuru. Selvam weaver ke paas jaana hai, Murugan se cotton lena hai, timeline fix karna hai. Dubai ko bhi update dena hai regularly.
quests.narrative_moment: Order details clear! Now time for production. Meet weavers, get raw material, approve samples!
quests.scenario: Traditional weaving unit with handlooms. Selvam the master weaver inspecting fabric on the loom. Colorful threads hanging. The rhythmic sound of weaving.

quests.quest_description: Production chal rahi hai par ek batch mein defect mil gaya! Color match nahi hai. Selvam se baat karni hai, replacement lena hai. Quality compromise nahi hogi.
quests.narrative_moment: Production is running! But quality check important. Found defect in one batch — solve without panic!
quests.scenario: Shop storage area with fabric stacks arranged neatly. Inspection checklist on clipboard. {{userName}} and Ravi checking pieces one by one. Good lighting.

quests.quest_description: Goods ready hain par export ke liye documentation chahiye. Customs office, bank, quality inspector — sab jagah jaana hai. Pehli baar export kar rahe ho, English mein sab handle karna hai.
quests.narrative_moment: Quality approved! Now need papers for export. Customs, bank, certificates — all in English!
quests.scenario: Shop office. Ravi with laptop showing export documentation guide. Papers and forms spread on desk. Learning session in progress.

quests.quest_description: Documents complete! Ab professional packing aur shipping arrange karna hai. Shipping company se milna hai, pickup arrange karna hai, Mr. Ahmed ko inform karna hai.
quests.narrative_moment: Documents ready! Now packing and shipping. Must reach Dubai safely!
quests.scenario: Packing facility with workers carefully packing textiles. Export-grade boxes and labels. Supervisor Rajan directing the team. Organized operation.

quests.quest_description: Shipment chal pada Dubai! Ab anxious wait. Tracking check karna hai, Dubai se queries aayengi. Family support important hai is time.
quests.narrative_moment: Shipment dispatched! Now wait. Check tracking, handle queries. Family is there!
quests.scenario: Shop office. Laptop showing shipment tracking map. {{userName}} and Ravi looking at screen anxiously. Tracking updates being refreshed.

quests.quest_description: Shipment pahunch gaya! Mr. Ahmed quality check kar rahe hain. Positive feedback aayega? Bahut important moment hai — first international delivery.
quests.narrative_moment: Shipment reached Dubai! Mr. Ahmed is checking. Will get positive feedback?
quests.scenario: Shop office. {{userName}} on phone, listening intently. Relief that delivery is complete but anxiety about quality feedback. Ravi nearby.

quests.quest_description: SUCCESS! Mr. Ahmed bahut khush hain! Ab bigger order ki baat ho rahi hai. Dubai visit ka invitation bhi! Business grow ho raha hai.
quests.narrative_moment: First order successful! Mr. Ahmed happy! New opportunities coming. Chance to visit Dubai!
quests.scenario: Shop office. Video call with Mr. Ahmed who looks pleased. Business discussion about expansion. Exciting opportunity being presented.

quests.quest_description: Dubai trip ki taiyaari shuru! Passport, visa, tickets — sab kuch arrange karna hai. Pehli baar international travel ke liye documents aur packing!
quests.narrative_moment: Going to Dubai! Very exciting but preparation is important. Check passport, apply visa, book tickets. Ravi and Priya will help!
quests.scenario: Textile shop office area. Ravi and {{userName}} at desk with documents spread out. Passport, papers, laptop showing visa requirements. Morning light through window.

quests.quest_description: Nikalne ka waqt aa gaya! Shop ki zimmedari Ravi ko deni hai, ghar pe vidaai leni hai, aur airport tak ka safar shuru.
quests.narrative_moment: Going to Dubai tomorrow! Today explain everything to Ravi at shop. Take farewell at home. Leave for airport!
quests.scenario: Textile shop. Ravi with notepad taking notes. {{userName}} explaining important tasks, pointing at client files. Keys and contact list on counter.

quests.quest_description: Security se boarding tak — pehli international flight ka anubhav! Immigration, duty free, aur finally plane mein!
quests.narrative_moment: Check-in done! Now security, immigration, and boarding. May feel nervous but do everything step by step!
quests.scenario: Airport security checkpoint. X-ray machines and metal detectors. Trays for belongings. Security staff giving instructions. Queue of passengers.

quests.quest_description: Dubai pahunch gaye! Immigration se hotel tak — naya desh, naya experience! Mr. Ahmed ka driver aayega lene.
quests.narrative_moment: DUBAI! Plane has landed. Now immigration, baggage claim, and Mr. Ahmed driver will meet outside. Be ready!
quests.scenario: Dubai airport immigration hall. Very modern and clean. Arabic and English signs everywhere. Efficient counters with officers. Digital displays.

quests.quest_description: Aaj Mr. Ahmed se milna hai unke office mein! Samples ready hain, presentation ready hai. Yeh meeting business badal sakti hai!
quests.narrative_moment: Meeting day is here! Wear formal dress, check samples, keep confidence. Mr. Ahmed office will be very impressive!
quests.scenario: Hotel room morning. {{userName}} in front of mirror adjusting tie. Textile samples laid on bed for review. Briefcase packed. Nervous excitement.

quests.quest_description: Meeting ke baad Dubai dekhne ka mauka! Farhan guide karega. Burj Khalifa, Mall, traditional dinner — sab experience karo!
quests.narrative_moment: Meeting successful! Now explore Dubai a bit. Farhan will show you famous places. Enjoy!
quests.scenario: Burj Khalifa observation deck at sunset. Stunning 360 degree city view. Glass walls and floors. Tourists taking photos. Golden evening light.

quests.quest_description: Final day in Dubai! Aaj deal pakki hogi. Contract signing, handshake, aur celebration! Yeh moment life badal dega!
quests.narrative_moment: Last day! Contract signing today. Read carefully, ask questions, and sign confidently. Big moment!
quests.scenario: Conference room with formal setup. Contract documents spread on table. Farhan with laptop explaining terms. Mr. Ahmed observing. Legal papers ready.

quests.quest_description: Dubai trip successful! Ab ghar wapsi. Gifts kharidna hai, flight pakadni hai, aur naye sapne lekar ghar jaana hai!
quests.narrative_moment: Time to go home! Pack up, checkout, go to airport. Achieved so much — now celebration at home!
quests.scenario: Hotel room morning. Open suitcase with clothes and gifts neatly arranged. Documents folder. Dubai souvenirs. {{userName}} on phone with Ravi.

quests.quest_description: Business badh gaya! Ab bade showroom mein shift ho rahe hain. Interior designer, contractor, bank manager — sabse English mein baat!
quests.narrative_moment: New showroom to set up! Lots to plan. Talk to designer, meet contractor, discuss loan with bank.
quests.scenario: Designer office with samples and catalogs. Modern furniture showroom photos on walls. Designer showing layout options on laptop.

quests.quest_description: Akele nahi ho sakte ab! Staff hire karna hai — interviews, training, team meetings. Leader banna hai!
quests.narrative_moment: You need a bigger team. Hire a team! Take interviews, give training, conduct meetings. Now you are the boss!
quests.scenario: Office meeting room. Candidate sitting across table. Resume papers in {{userName}} hand. Professional interview setup.

quests.quest_description: Mr. Ahmed ki team India aa rahi hai factory visit ke liye! Airport pickup se dinner tak — host banna hai!
quests.narrative_moment: Ahmed's team from Dubai is coming! To visit the factory. Airport pickup, factory tour, business lunch, dinner hosting — all on you!
quests.scenario: Airport arrivals. {{userName}} holding welcome sign. Dubai team emerging with luggage. Role reversal moment.

quests.quest_description: Bete ke school mein function hai. Parent-teacher meeting, relatives ki badhaiyan, family get-together!
quests.narrative_moment: Family time! A School function to attend, meeting relatives, celebration dinner. Everyone is proud of you!
quests.scenario: School auditorium. Parents seated. Teacher approaching {{userName}}. Son performing on stage.

quests.quest_description: Best Exporter Award mil raha hai! Award ceremony, media interview, industry leaders se mulaqat!
quests.narrative_moment: You ae about to get the Best Exporter Award! Ceremony to attend! Stage speech, media interview, networking with VIPs. Big day!
quests.scenario: Convention center entrance. Registration desk. Business people in formal wear. Banner showing awards.

quests.quest_description: Dubai ke baad ab UK se bhi enquiry aa rahi hai! International expansion ka naya chapter!
quests.narrative_moment: Call from UK! New international clients, video meetings, discuss quotations!
quests.scenario: Office cabin. International call on phone. {{userName}} handling enquiry professionally. World map on wall.

quests.quest_description: Success ke baad dena bhi zaroori hai. Young entrepreneurs ko mentor karo, community mein help karo!
quests.narrative_moment: Time to give back! Teach youngsters, participate in community events!
quests.scenario: Coffee shop meeting. Young person with notebook eager to learn. {{userName}} sharing wisdom.

quests.quest_description: Journey complete! Family celebration, Dubai partnership anniversary, aur nayi shuruwaat ki planning!
quests.narrative_moment: Dream achieved! Grand celebration, special call from Mr. Ahmed, future planning with family!
quests.scenario: New showroom entrance decorated. Ribbon cutting ceremony. Guests gathered. Media present.
